_description: Every npm package INLINED into packages/aai-studio-server/dist/index.mjs, which compiles aai-server in. Only ever lowered — see scripts/check-bundled-deps.mjs for what a new entry costs.
_external: modal and microsandbox are deliberately NOT here: they are `external` in that package's tsdown.config.ts because they (and modal's whole tree — protobufjs, @grpc/*, cbor-x/cbor-extract, detect-libc, node-gyp-build-optional-packages) resolve files relative to their own package, which a bundled copy cannot do.
